name: How long does an accessibility bathroom remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessibility bathroom remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom accessibility project, like a tub-to-shower conversion, typically takes one to two weeks once materials arrive and work begins. Larger renovations, such as full accessible bathroom reconfigurations, kitchen adjustments, or mother-in-law suite additions, take longer due to framing, plumbing relocation, drywall work, and permitting. Planning ahead is vital: selecting specialized fixtures early and scheduling an on-site evaluation helps prevent project delays and ensures the space is adapted to your household's schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A focused bathroom conversion usually takes one to two weeks, while extensive layout reconfigurations or home additions require several weeks.
